ward.description: Biomedical. Overhead view (horizontal plane) of a 2R patient-positioning arm beside a treatment couch. Obstacles: the patient's head (disc), an IV pole and a monitor cart. Continuous-rotation joints, so the C-space is a torus (wrap = true). The arm must move a probe holder from its parking pose (start) to a pose beside the patient's head (goal). Illustrative values.

eod.description: Defence (protective use). Side view (vertical plane) of a 2R arm on the deck of an EOD (bomb-disposal) UGV; base at the origin, ground at y = -0.35 m. Obstacles: a vehicle bumper and an overhanging pipe (discs). Joints have cable stops at +-180 deg (wrap = false). The arm must move from its stowed pose (start) to an inspection pose with the camera/gripper under the bumper (goal). Illustrative values.
